generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to grasp the dark green avocado on the right side of the table and lifts it from the tabletop. It carries the avocado to the wire fruit basket's lower tier, lowers it inside, and opens its fingers to leave the avocado in the basket. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The avocado is visibly inside the lower wire-basket tier, lying more horizontally than during the grasp. The robot’s right fingers are open adjacent to it; the left hand remains raised and idle. No subsequent withdrawal is visible.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: approaches, grasps, lifts, carries and releases the avocado in the lower wire basket.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains raised and open over the left side of the table throughout; does not grasp, support or stabilize the avocado or basket.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer or human assistance is visible.

uncertainties: Exact contact with the basket wires is partly occluded by the open right fingers at the ending; the avocado is visibly inside the lower tier, and no later hand withdrawal or prolonged resting state is shown.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
